complete_examples.text: Therefore, based on the domestic inverse al-gorithms of spectrum density which have been relatively matured, and the consideration of the uniformity in the conversion process of spectrum density in time and frequency domain, this paper proposed a simplified inverse algorithm which can directly simulate any wave -band at any length of the track irregularity spatial series on the basis of acquiring the spectrum density structure and fitting parameters.
